summary: The most consequential problem is that the faecal impaction check and diagnosis drop the '> 65 years' arm of the page's criterion, so older patients who are not bed-bound or in palliative care are never checked. Shock is encoded as a bare concept without the footnote 1 criteria (pulse, RR, confusion, weakness), and the 5-day cholera-exposure window is dropped. Nothing is invented; the diarrhoea > 2 weeks branch (HIV, giardiasis, cryptosporidium/isospora) has no rules, which is acceptable only if management is out of scope.
